name: Character Assassination
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of character assassination, where believers may face false accusations and reviling for their faith, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:11. Despite such attacks, Psalm 11:1 encourages trust in the Lord rather than fleeing from slander. Isaiah 53:1 highlights the unbelief and rejection that can accompany God's message, underscoring the difficulty of enduring unjust reproach. Believers are called to respond with humility and restoration, as Galatians 6:1 and James 5:16 instruct us to gently restore those who falter and confess faults to one another, relying on fervent prayer for healing and strength.
